name: unit_lineage
title: Unit lineage links (data/unit_lineage.csv)
description: Hand-maintained. One row per lineage link between two unit records of data/units.csv: the successor continues the predecessor (redesignation, reconstitution, absorption or formation from remnants). Unit records are never merged; the link is dated and sourced. Not a command relation.

fields.name: lineage_id
fields.description: Stable key UL001 onward. Never reused.

fields.name: predecessor_unit_id
fields.description: The earlier unit record (a unit_id of data/units.csv).

fields.name: successor_unit_id
fields.description: The later unit record (a unit_id of data/units.csv); differs from the predecessor.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: How the successor continues the predecessor.

fields.name: effective_date
fields.description: Date the successor takes over the lineage: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Not before the predecessor's formed_date (when set).

fields.name: date_basis
fields.description: Where the date comes from (vocabulary relationship_date_basis).

fields.name: reference_ids
fields.description: ';'-separated reference ids of data/references_meta.csv; at least one.

fields.name: note
fields.description: What the source says (paraphrased), and any conflicting date.
